en: Black‑and‑white photograph showing an older man in a suit and flat cap standing at a stall in an outdoor market. He holds a small statue of a woman descending a staircase, while in front of him and hanging from the stall structure are various metal objects and curios: bells, bowls, kettles, pitchers, figurines, and other antiques or bric‑a‑brac. The scene looks candid and documentary, with no clear modern elements, suggesting an early‑20th‑century flea or street market. The card front appears to have no printed caption.
